issues: Document has no ТР ТС section-heading rows anywhere (only Roman/Arabic category headers such as 'I ПИЩЕВЫЕ ПРОДУКТЫ...', '1.1', '2.2' etc.), so tr_section is null on every row per the rule. Several table rows have their object/OKPD2/ТН ВЭД cells visually merged with (blank under) the row above in the source; per the no-invention rule these were left null rather than inferred (rows 3, 4, 5, 11, 23, 24). Rows 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 15, 24, 25, 30, 41, 51, 58 each combine several indicators and/or sub-objects under one numbered table row in the source; each indicator was emitted as its own JSON row per the schema rule, repeating norm_doc/object/codes. Row 26's range 'от 0,1 до 6×10^4 Бк' was kept with range_to as the literal printed value '6×10^4' (scientific-notation-style unit, not a plain decimal). Row 21's indicator text ('Массовая доля белка по Барнштейну') and row 7's col.8 citation ('...Таможенного союза от 18.06.2010 № 317') each span a page break and were merged into a single value. All 13 pages were read at 150dpi with no rotated pages; a few multi-line cells required 300dpi crops to disambiguate row boundaries around the page 2/3 and page 5/6 breaks. No illegible content was encountered.
